questions.text: Two numbers, m and n, are such that the sum of 4% of m and 6% of n is equal to half of the sum of 7% of m and 14% of n. Determine the ratio of m : n.

There are 13 members in group A, 10 members in group B and 45 members in group C. All the members of these groups went to a restaurant. The average amount spent on each member of group A, B and C is ₹367, ₹112 and ₹401, respectively. The total average amount (in ₹) spent per member is:
A can complete a task in 16 days, and B can complete the same task in 24 days. If A and B work on alternate days starting with A, in how many days will the task be completed?

Two trains having lengths of 240 m and 410 m are running at speeds of 80 km/h and 110 km/h, respectively, in the same direction. The time taken (in minutes) by the faster train, coming from behind, to completely cross the other train is:
Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2000 at 6.75% per annum rate of interest for the period from 3 February 2023 to 17 April 2023.
Asha bought a mixer for ₹2,160 and sold it for ₹1,998. Find the loss percentage.
The capacity of a cuboidal tank of water is 62000 litres. Find the breadth of the tank, if its length and depth are 2.5 m and 10 m, respectively.
The marked price of an electronic watch in a store is ₹25,960, and it is available at a discount of 20%. What is the price (in ₹) that a customer pays if he buys it from the store?
LCM and HCF of two numbers are 54 and 9 respectively. If one of the numbers is 18, then find the other number.

Four runners started running simultaneously from a point on a circular track. They took 280 seconds, 350 seconds, 420 seconds and 560 seconds, respectively, to complete one round. After how much time (in seconds) do they meet at the starting point for the first time?
In an experiment, the refractive index of water was found to be 1.35, 1.29, 1.32 and 1.36. What is the average refractive index of water?

Manoj has ₹1230 with him. He divided it amongst his sons Anand and Anil and asked them to invest it at 5% rate of interest compounded annually. It was seen that Anand and Anil got same amount after 12 and 13 years respectively. How much (in ₹) did Manoj give to Anil?
LCM and HCF of two numbers are 54 and 9 respectively. If one of the numbers is 18, then find the other number.
If at same rate of interest, in 2 years, the simple interest is ₹42 and compound interest is ₹45, then what is the principal (in ₹)?
A, B and C are sections of Class X. The ratio of A : B is 9 : 4 and that of A : C is 3 : 2. Find A : B : C.
400 apples were bought at ₹1240 per hundred and were sold at a profit of ₹840. Find the selling price (in ₹) per dozen of apples.
